title: Texas Cyclone
description: A wandering cowpoke is shocked when the inhabitants of a Western community treat him like a long-lost friend.

title: The Blazing Trail
description: A worthless gold mine leads the Durango Kid and a newspaperman on a trail marked by suspicion and deceit.

title: The Taming of the West
description: A new lawman (Bill Elliott) punches out cattle rustlers who like to shoot sheriffs.

title: Trail of the Rustlers
description: A woman and her two sons plot to drive other ranchers from their land after they discover a secret water source.

title: Arizona
description: A drifter (William Holden) and the cavalry help the first woman (Jean Arthur) in Tucson protect her freight line from Indians.

title: Stranger From Arizona
description: A quiet cowboy (Buck Jones) on a white horse saves a gal (Dorothy Fay) from cattle rustlers.

title: Hangman's Knot
description: A Confederate (Randolph Scott) and his men rob Union gold in Nevada, then learn the war's been over for a month.

title: Count Three and Pray
description: A preacher (Van Heflin) with a reckless past rebuilds a church after the Civil War with a teenage girl (Joanne Woodward) from the hills.

title: The Westerner
description: A rancher (Tim McCoy) and his buddy (Joseph Sauers) scare rustlers out of business.

title: Good Day for a Hanging
description: The new marshal (Fred MacMurray) is the only one in town who thinks a charming killer (Robert Vaughn) should hang.

title: Fury at Gunsight Pass
description: One bank robber (David Brian) double-crosses another (Neville Brand), giving the undertaker and others a chance at the loot.

title: Seminole Uprising
description: An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.

title: The Mountain Men
description: Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.

title: Al Jennings of Oklahoma
description: Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.

title: The Nebraskan
description: War looms on the horizon when an Army officer's American Indian aide is accused of murdering a tribal elder.

title: Edge of Eternity
description: An Arizona lawman (Cornel Wilde) traps a killer gold thief (Mickey Shaughnessy) and his hostage (Victoria Shaw) in a yellow tram spanning the Grand Canyon.

title: Relentless
description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

title: The Great Sioux Massacre
description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

title: Riding Wild
description: A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

title: The Desert Horseman
description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch up to payroll robbers.

title: 3:10 to Yuma
description: A rancher (Van Heflin) needing cash is hired to put an outlaw (Glenn Ford) on the train to Yuma prison.

title: Streets of Ghost Town
description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) look for stolen gold with a history.

title: Gunman's Walk
description: A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.

title: King of the Wild Horses
description: A mustang stallion runs swiftly to the rescue when the boy who befriended him is endangered.

title: The Man From Colorado
description: A homicidal Civil War colonel (Glenn Ford) turns federal judge, with his former aide as marshal (William Holden).

title: The Wild Westerners
description: A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.

title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
description: An Army deserter (Audie Murphy) shows defenseless Texas women how to hold off Indians out to avenge a massacre.

title: Gunmen From Laredo
description: A framed Texas rancher escapes from prison for a showdown with a saloon keeper.

title: The Hard Man
description: A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).

title: Wyoming Renegades
description: An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.

title: The Violent Men
description: A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.

title: A Lawless Street
description: The wife (Angela Lansbury) of a roving marshal (Randolph Scott) wants him to quit, but first he has to clean up Medicine Bend.

title: White Eagle
description: An Indian pony-express rider C1 catches post-Civil War horse thieves.

title: Three Hours to Kill
description: The inhabitants of a small western community turn on Jim Guthrie (Dana Andrews) when he becomes the prime suspect for a murder he didn't commit.

title: Fighting Fool
description: A sheriff (Tim McCoy) flirts with a local girl (Marceline Day) and chases an outlaw called the Shadow.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: The Last Frontier

title: Go West, Young Girl!
